summary: Backend regression and live UI testing completed. Auth, protected dashboard, registration search, pass generation, invalid QR handling, dashboard metrics, and mobile overflow passed. Scanner route crashes during camera startup cleanup.

minor.issue: Authentication is bearer-token/localStorage based; no httpOnly cookie is issued and CORS is configured with allow_credentials=false. This differs from the supplied auth playbook and increases browser token exposure.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening /scanner causes a React runtime error: Cannot stop, scanner is not running or paused. The camera preview never becomes usable and the app error overlay is shown.

integration_issues.issue: Html5Qrcode start failure is followed by unconditional qr.stop() cleanup; stop rejects when the scanner never started, producing an uncaught runtime error.

action_items: Guard scanner cleanup so qr.stop() only runs after successful start (or ignore the not-running rejection), and add a camera permission/error fallback that does not crash the React tree.
Add unique data-testid attributes to remaining interactive controls such as the scanner Exit link and import View registrations link.
Decide whether auth should follow the supplied httpOnly-cookie playbook; if so, implement secure cookie issuance, explicit credentialed CORS, and logout cookie clearing.
Update seed_admin to reconcile an existing admin password when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes, rather than only seeding when the user is absent.
critical_code_review_comments: Scanner useEffect cleanup calls qr.stop() unconditionally even when qr.start() failed; this is the direct cause of the reproducible uncaught runtime crash.
Registrations useEffect calls a function recreated on every render and omits it from dependencies, producing an ESLint exhaustive-deps warning and risking stale search behavior.
seed_defaults only inserts an admin and does not update an existing admin password, contrary to the auth playbook requirement.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (desktop/mobile core flows pass; scanner flow fails)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Existing six imported registrations and existing scan activity were used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login, dashboard metrics/activity, registrations search, pass generation feedback, invalid QR API response, and mobile no-overflow were verified. Re-test scanner startup with camera permission denied and allowed, then verify valid QR and duplicate UI outcomes. CSV preview/import and valid/duplicate API scan flow were previously manually verified by the prior agent but not repeated in this iteration.
rca of the issue: On /scanner, Html5Qrcode.start({facingMode:'environment'}, ...) rejects in the browser environment. The effect cleanup immediately invokes qr.stop() regardless of whether start completed; html5-qrcode rejects stop with 'Cannot stop, scanner is not running or paused', which escapes the cleanup and triggers the React runtime error overlay. Mitigate with a started ref/state and catch/ignore cleanup rejection, while rendering the existing CAMERA_ERROR result instead of allowing an uncaught exception.
